verificationSummary: Editor commit ae6978e3646e6ac4bbedc6ec15e6e38343bf0585 adds a bounded add-node activation harness. src/editor/backend/backendTransport.ts now types active Backend mutation request operations for columns.insert and text-block.insert. src/editor/backend/backendMutationRunner.ts adds createBackendAddNodeMutationRequest and runBackendAddNodeMutation; these functions only convert an existing ready Editor add-node contract into a BackendMutationRequest when the Editor runtime has a fresh Core read envelope, the contract documentId/baseRevision matches the current Editor state, and a compatible Backend capability response advertises the requested operation kind for the current package/document pair. The runner then calls FlowDocBackendClient.commitMutation and applies the Backend mutation result through the existing applyRuntimeBackendMutationResult stale gate. src/tests/addNodeActivationHarness.test.ts proves the missing-capability block and ready-capability path, then starts a real flowdoc-vnext-backend loopback server with product-report-vnext-minimal, reads capabilities and the active document, runs columns.insert at zone-cover-body index 1, applies the returned revision 4 read envelope into Editor runtime state, then runs text-block.insert into summary-left and applies the returned revision 5 read envelope into Editor runtime state. RED evidence: npm test -- src/tests/addNodeActivationHarness.test.ts failed before implementation with TypeError: createBackendAddNodeMutationRequest is not a function. GREEN focused evidence: npm test -- src/tests/addNodeActivationHarness.test.ts passed 1 file and 2 tests. Editor worktree npm run check and merged Editor main npm run check both passed type-check, Vitest with 97 passed test files and 334 tests, and build. This evidence does not enable visible add-node UI, WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, active text input, React canvas input binding, durable draft persistence, document v4 insert semantics, table/toc/page-break/divider/spacer/table row/table column add paths, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, large-document authoring performance, accessibility readiness, exact layout, export parity, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. The existing Editor add-node placement and contract builders still carry blocked activation status until a separate UI activation lane changes visible behavior. Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning, and Editor npm install reported 5 high severity audit findings; neither was remediated in this lane. After merge, branch editor-add-node-activation-harness-20260830 was deleted and Git worktree metadata for C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-anah-0830 is no longer registered, but the folder remains on disk after git worktree remove failed with Filename too long and direct recursive deletion was blocked by local tool policy. A post-cleanup status check showed tracked Core deletions under packages/text-engine-rust-wasm; those exact tracked paths were restored from HEAD and Core status returned clean. The older C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-ati-0830 worktree remains intentionally retained detached at d2290b47a37adc8aee2067ed4e094c6f39350b6c because node_modules contains junctions to Core and cleanup still needs a safer dependency-link plan.
